The '''Talz Commandos''' was a group of [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] warriors who allied themselves with the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] and assisted their military efforts on the ice worlds of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] and [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. [[Fetzellen]] and [[Broonmark]] were members of the group.
